cocoon.title: Cocoon AI
cocoon.autostartDesc: Start the Cocoon runner automatically when the browser launches, after proxy, bridge and storage are connected. Off by default.

stake.noActiveStake: No active stake. Start the runner from the AI page to register a client contract.
stake.cooldownHint: Once the cooldown ends, claim the refund to send your stake back to the cocoon wallet.
stake.refundReady: Cooldown elapsed. Claim the refund to close the contract.
stake.refundReadyHint: The staked amount will be returned to your cocoon wallet. You can then cashout to your owner wallet.
stake.confirmUnstake: Unstaking starts a cooldown. The runner will be paid until you confirm the refund after the cooldown ends.
stake.confirmClaim: Claim the refund and close the contract. Your stake will be returned to the cocoon wallet.
stake.confirmCashout: Stop the runner and send {{amount}} GRAM from the cocoon wallet to your owner wallet?
stake.unstakeSent: Unstake request sent. Waiting for on-chain confirmation.
stake.cashoutDone: Cashed out {{amount}} GRAM to owner wallet.
stake.runnerOfflineHint: Start the runner to unstake or claim your refund. The countdown keeps running on-chain regardless.
stake.fundCocoonHint: Top up the cocoon wallet (≥ 5 GRAM) to register a new client contract.
stake.readyDesc: Cocoon wallet is funded. Click Start to register and begin chatting.
stake.readyFundDesc: Main wallet has enough GRAM. Click Activate to fund a fresh Cocoon wallet and start.
stake.fundOwnerDesc: Keep at least 20.1 GRAM in your main wallet to activate Cocoon, or pull existing residuals back to your main wallet.
stake.actionWithdrawDesc: Stops Cocoon and returns the channel funds to your main wallet automatically.
stake.actionWithdrawingDesc: Withdrawal is already running. No extra action is needed.
stake.actionStartDesc: Start Cocoon with the funds already available in the Cocoon wallet.
stake.actionFundAndStartDesc: Fund a fresh Cocoon wallet from your main wallet, then start Cocoon.
stake.actionTopUpDesc: Keep at least 20.1 GRAM in your main wallet before activating Cocoon.
stake.withdrawAutoDesc: Keep the wallet connected. The app will claim and send funds back automatically.

flow.unstakeSent: Recovery started. Your funds will return to your main wallet.
flow.cashoutDone: {{amount}} GRAM returned to your main wallet.

stage.confirmingDesc: Transaction sent. Waiting for the contract state to confirm the unlock.
stage.cooldownDesc: The contract returned a future unlock timestamp. Funds will be claimed and sent automatically as soon as possible.
stage.claimingDesc: Unlock elapsed. Claiming the refund and closing the contract.
stage.cashingOutDesc: Refund received. Sending the final balance to your main wallet.

noStake.title: No active stake
noStake.description: Start Cocoon to register a client contract, or cashout your cocoon wallet to the owner wallet.

closing.title: Stake closing
closing.description: Your unstake request was sent. Wait for the on-chain unlock, then claim the refund.

cooldown.title: Unlock in progress
cooldown.description: Inference is paused while the on-chain unlock runs. The refund will be claimed once it elapses.

refundable.title: Refund ready
refundable.description: Unlock elapsed. Claim the refund to return your stake to the cocoon wallet.

closed.title: Stake closed
closed.description: Your stake is closed. Restake to chat again, or cashout the residual funds to the owner wallet.

withdrawing.title: Withdrawing your stake
withdrawing.description: Cocoon is automatically progressing through unlock, refund and cashout. You can leave this open or come back later.

recovery.sectionDesc: Recover GRAM from current and archived Cocoon wallets. The app only reports a lock if the contract itself returns one on-chain.
recovery.primaryDesc: Stops Cocoon, inspects current and archived Cocoon wallets, claims any immediately recoverable client funds, and sends balances back to your main wallet.
recovery.orphanDesc: An old Cocoon identity was archived without a known client contract address. Paste the contract address (visible in your wallet history when you funded the stake) to start the refund.
recovery.enqueueSuccess: Recovery started. The backend will inspect the contract and recover anything immediately available.
recovery.recoverSuccess: Recovery action sent {{txs}} transaction(s). {{locked}} contract(s) reported an on-chain lock.
recovery.lockedHint: A locked item means the client contract returned a future unlock timestamp on-chain.

phase.refundPendingDesc: Refund request submitted on-chain. Waiting for the contract to enter its unlock phase.
phase.cooldownDesc: On-chain unlock is running. Funds will be claimed and sent back automatically.
phase.claimPendingDesc: Unlock elapsed. Claiming the refund and closing the contract.
phase.drainPendingDesc: Refund received. Draining the cocoon wallet back to your main wallet.
phase.doneDesc: Recovery complete. The GRAM has been returned to your main wallet.
phase.failedDesc: Recovery failed. Check the error and remove the entry, or retry.

themePage.basicColorsDescription: The main colors that define the theme.

general.routingDescription: Your traffic is encrypted in 3 layers and routed through independent relays. Each relay only knows its immediate neighbors, never the full path.

general.chainDisabledError: The {{chain}} resolver is disabled. Enable it in Settings > Name Services.
